page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8is-8x.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture GPU-accelerated server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated Intel Xeon 6462C vCPUs operating at a baseline frequency of 3.3 GHz, paired with 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

The instance is equipped with eight NVIDIA L20 GPUs from the Ada Lovelace architecture family, delivering a combined total of 384 GB of VRAM. This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage.

Network performance is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps. The lack of local NVMe storage represents an architectural tradeoff, requiring reliance on external storage solutions, which is offset by the high-density GPU and memory configuration. This resource density makes it a highly specialized, cost-efficient platform for large-scale parallel processing without the overhead of local disk maintenance.

This hardware profile is designed for GPU-intensive workloads such as deep learning training, large language model inference, high-performance computing, and complex data science simulations that require massive parallel processing capabilities and high network throughput.
